searchText: Is there a discord I can ask questions about staking? A staking discord? I want to know which eth1 client is best for use with a raspberry pi https://discord.gg/6NQ6yzc7 Great thanks Please give me some test token on Sepolia, 0x0f14341A7f464320319025540E8Fe48Ad0fe5aec It seems MSF8 merge will occur soon. `53,290,823,313,153,069,154,304`: MSF8 TTD `53,290,766,291,635,463,122,733`: https://etherscan.io/block/15081262 MSF8 Activated ``` Jul 05 07:58:48.447 INFO Proof of Stake Activated slot: 11969, service: beacon Jul 05 07:58:48.447 INFO Terminal POW Block Hash: 0x8155e14e0d0f54a154a81238e965e6916559e4d797e54d6a09eba9ee3bf9f41e, service: beacon Jul 05 07:58:48.447 INFO Merge Transition Block Root: 0x53f0131f154c525fc731258d7d109b116deff2038f49977492220be59757f8e3, service: beacon ``` oh wow, hashrate picked up a ton overnight? Did MSF8 go smoothly or anything wonky worth to report? How's the state growth for the beaconnode on ropsten or post merge in general? Does anyone track this? i assume geth won't grow post merge? No it grows with the same speed that it currently does Is the target for Sepolia TTD still 2pm UTC tomorrow? Here’s the more or less official estimation: http://bordel.wtf yeah, i monitor that, but the devs presumably will adjust hashrate to more or less hit their desired target so trying to understand if that desired target is still 2pm UTC like it says at bordel.wtf We're trying to get it for tomorrow, but running into hiccups because the high hashrate results in tons of uncles, effectively "diluting" it. Still aiming for tomorrow, but I wouldn't guarantee a time 😅
